# Check that deduplication worked: should now have 848 - 48 = 800 unique patients

# Check that arm has exactly two values
treatment_count = len(df_dedup[df_dedup['arm'] == 'treatment'])
control_count = len(df_dedup[df_dedup['arm'] == 'control'])

# Compute response rate per arm
